newsitem.title: LATVIA: VELDZE IN TALKS WITH FOREIGN PARTNERS.
newsitem.headline: VELDZE IN TALKS WITH FOREIGN PARTNERS.

text.p: Veldze soft drinks factory said on Monday that it currently is in talks with foreign partners, following failed attempts earlier to produce Pepsi-Cola products.
"We are currently in talks with new potential foreign partners following the failed attempt to team up with Pepsi," Ivars Ilzinsh, Veldze's manager, told Reuters.
Veldze earlier had the rights to produce some Pepsi-Cola drinks, now being imported by Pepsi's representatives in Poland.
"After these talks, expected to be complete by the second half of 1997, we will definitely have a more clear-cut future strategy," Ilzinsh added.
Veldze is 51 percent controlled by Mono company and 26.5 percent of its shares were sold in a public offer.
Mono has to invest 300,000 lats in the company by January 1999.
"The controlling stake owner has invested approximately 10,000 lats to date," Ilzinsh said.
